entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Iberian Revolutionary Liberation Directorate was an armed organization that operated from 1958 to 1964, formed by Spaniards and Portuguese opponents of the Iberian dictatorships. The organization had two general secretaries, the Portuguese, Humberto Delgado and, the Galician, Xosé Velo Mosquera.
